p: LORD was with Joseph: The favour of God is the fountain of all prosperity.
overseer over his house: Because God prospered him: and so he made religion serve his profit.
blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's: The wicked are blessed by the company of the godly.
and he knew not ought he: For he was sure that everything would prosper: therefore he ate and drank and did not worry.
Lie with me: In this word he declares the purpose she was working towards.
God: The fear of God preserved him against her continual temptations.
cried with a loud voice: This declares that in which lack of restraint exists and to this is joined extreme impudency and deceit.
prison: His bad treatment in the prison may be gathered from Ps 105:18.
whatsoever they did there: That is, nothing was done without his commandment.
